summary: Selling has eased from the pre-open slump, but the Nifty is still down about 0.4% below 22,550, on course for an eighth straight weekly loss.

detail.leaders: Autos in focus on September sales (M&M)
detail.tone: The Nifty has trimmed its pre-open loss of about 0.8% to roughly 0.4%, but there is no real dip-buying ahead of the three-day break.
watch: Maruti and Tata Motors sales numbers
A break below 22,400, flagged by IIFL as a risk level

top.title: M&M sales up 15%; Bajaj Auto up 5%
top.line: M&M sold 1,14,874 vehicles in September; Bajaj Auto's total rose to 5,38,443 units
more: M&M SUV volumes rose 14% to 64,092 units
Bajaj Auto sold 5,10,504 units a year earlier
Maruti is estimated at about 2.38 lakh units vs 1.89 lakh a year ago

top.title: SEBI clears NSE corporate bond index futures
top.line: NSE received SEBI's no-objection certificate for futures on a corporate bond index
more: The product adds a hedging tool for corporate bond portfolios
It may support market making and price discovery in corporate bonds

top.title: Hospital stocks extend slide on pricing fears
top.line: Apollo and Max Healthcare lead the declines again after the SC remarks on drug mark-ups
more: The sell-off continues for a second session
Investors fear tighter rules on hospital pharmacy margins
